title: Quadratic 2-Adic Newton-Hensel Matrix Inversion and Zero-Ancilla Phase Decoupling
claims: For any U in Z_{2^m}^{n x n} with det(U) == 1 (mod 2), the Newton-Hensel iteration V_{j+1} = V_j(2I - UV_j) mod 2^{2^{j+1}} squares the residual I - UV_j at each step and reaches U^{-1} mod 2^m in ceil(log_2 m) steps.
Preconditioning n coupled DCP wires by V_L^T decouples U^T s mod 2^m into n independent 1D scalar phase registers with 100% product state fidelity.
favorable_controls: 3x3 matrix inversion mod 2^8 = 256 in 3 Newton steps
4x4 matrix inversion mod 2^16 = 65536 in 4 Newton steps
